The independent product review has been completed and the release verdict has been written to [REVIEW.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-E7JbV5/workspace/REVIEW.md). No product files were modified.

### Release Verdict: BLOCK

### Summary of What Was Verified
1. **Product Acceptance Gate (`accept-check.js`)**: Executed with independent acceptor context (`--acceptor-context separate --runtime-verified`). Returned **BLOCK** due to missing `Trust` section in [ARCHITECTURE.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-E7JbV5/workspace/ARCHITECTURE.md) (`P-section-trust`) and missing operability docs/health endpoints (`D-operability-report`).
2. **UX Walkthrough Replay ([ux-walkthrough.md](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-E7JbV5/workspace/ux-walkthrough.md))**: Failed at Step 1. [public/index.html](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-E7JbV5/workspace/public/index.html) lacks the declared sign-in form and sign-out buttons. Loading the page triggers a client-side `TypeError` in [public/app.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-E7JbV5/workspace/public/app.js) because `/api/invoices` returns a 401 response without an active session.
3. **Engineering & Architecture Audit**: Identified authentication mismatch ([src/server.js](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-E7JbV5/workspace/src/server.js) requires `req.session.staffId`, while `app.js` sends an unvalidated `x-billing-token` header), hardcoded client token constants in `app.js`, and missing test coverage for API endpoints.
